Aisha (CS): Heads-up: VectorGrid renewal hit our queue. Procurement is pushing to switch from annual prepay to quarterly billing and insists on billing to their EU entity (VectorGrid GmbH). They also asked for a vendor-signed penetration test PDF and confirmation that our KMS key policy is enforced.
Dan (AE): Quarterly billing is a material change — pricing needs an uplift. I proposed a 3% premium to Owen verbally; can Finance sign off on quarterly cadence with net30?
Owen (Finance): Quarterly net30 is doable if we run a quick credit check. We'll need their EU VAT ID, beneficiary bank details, and the PO number to map invoices. Send me the contact.
Aisha (CS): Procurement gave a PO: VG-EU-559. Contact is payables@vectorgrid.eu. They want the contract signed by the US parent but invoice issued to the German entity. Any legal constraints?
Claire (Legal): We can add a billing-entity addendum that allows split-signature (US parent signs, invoice to German subsidiary) provided we have a signed intercompany/reseller addendum on file. I'll draft a short addendum and provisionally open a DocuSign envelope. Also need pen-test PDF attached before e-sign.
OnboardingBot: Onboarding checklist created: VG-ONB-128  Tracks SSO, KMS policy checks, post-sign webhook provisioning.
Dan (AE): I'll ask them for the vendor-signed pen-test and the reseller agreement. Also confirming whether SSO is required before go-live or can be staged post-sign.
Aisha (CS): They said SSO must be enforced in prod before onboarding any seats. KMS must be configured with key rotation policy enabled. Tom from Onboarding confirmed we can enable rotation within 48h after their infra accepts the IAM invite.
Owen (Finance): If they want quarterly billing we need the VAT ID and beneficiary info. I've emailed payables@vectorgrid.eu and requested: VAT ID, bank (IBAN + SWIFT), and the billing contact for 3-way invoice confirmation.
Claire (Legal): Envelope EN-2077 created for VectorGrid  Amendment + billing-addendum. Waiting to attach pen-test PDF and reseller addendum. I'll include a proration schedule in case of mid-quarter start.
Dan (AE): Update from procurement: they've assigned infra lead katia.ops@vectorgrid.eu and said pen-test will be posted by EOD. If Katia accepts the IAM role today we can flip KMS rotation and mark onboarding as "blocked -> ready" in 48h.
Aisha (CS): OK — I'll monitor. Reminder: the quarterly pricing premium offer expires in 5 business days. If docs + signature complete before then we keep the discount; otherwise we revert to standard renewal terms. I'll post artifacts here when they arrive.
